verdict.rationale: Spline ships an official MCP Server bundled in its desktop app that lets agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, etc.) directly drive the editor to create/modify scenes, plus a Real-time API, webhooks, and Code API for programmatic write access — going well beyond read-only access. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party report confirming the MCP write-agent workflow in practice (only vendor docs), and no public OpenAPI/REST spec for external programmatic write access.
